record.text: I think data center opposition is perfectly rational; there are plenty of documented cases where it materially worsens living conditions for people nearby (noise, light, air pollution) while the community gets almost nothing of value out of the center itself (they require minimal staff to run).

More than half of Americans are barely getting by, living on the cusp of poverty and struggling. That's what the headline is telling us. More than half of Americans are destitute, while Trump's inner circle and billionaires and Megacorporations continue to rob us all blind and blame minorities.
